messages:
eli: Heads up — since ~03:12 UTC we're seeing a spike of failed GPU node joins in usw2. Nodes are getting stuck during the keystore decrypt handshake. STS grant errors + audit sampler QPS jumped. Putting it here in case it's related to the ephemeral-role tweak rolled yesterday.

samir: looking. can you paste the exact decrypt error or logs?

eli: paste from node-provisioner logs:
```
2025-07-12T03:13:08Z node-1234 ERROR keystore.decrypt failed status=AccessDenied detail=STS:InvalidIdentityToken grant_id=ephemeral-20250712-02:45
2025-07-12T03:13:11Z node-1235 WARN join retry=3 reason=keystore.decrypt
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: ephemeral-iam-rollout v2.3.1 applied to region=usw2 at 02:45 UTC (author=taylor).

maria: Is this the rollout that tightened kms:Decrypt to require encryptionContext? If so that would break old ephemeral grants which weren't including the context.

samir: confirmed in IAM traces: assume-role tokens for onboarding flow are missing encryptionContext, STS returns InvalidIdentityToken. It's causing retries which in turn increase audit sampling and egress.

taylor: cost flag — the join retries are inflating auditship QPS and S3 egress (logs + keystore snapshots). We're already seeing a small billing blip in metrics. Do we want immediate rollback or a targeted exception?

eli: short-term plan proposal: 1) apply a temporary policy exception to allow existing ephemeral grants to decrypt for 1 hour 2) reduce audit-sampler rate for "node-join" events to 10% for 30m to limit egress cost and noise 3) open a follow-up to include encryptionContext in the ephemeral grant flow.

maria: +1 for exception but we need a documented window and an owner. Also request: add a canary in rollout policy so next change only hits staging for 1 hour.

samir: I can create a temp IAM policy and attach to the onboarding role with a time-limited condition (expires 04:30 UTC). Will also add audit annotations so we can track usage. Applying now to staging then prod pending approval.

ops-bot: iam-bot: temp-policy onboarding-ephemeral-exception created (expires=2025-07-12T04:30:00Z). staged in staging; prod apply pending @maria approval.

taylor: If prod needs security approval and that adds latency, please at least throttle the sampler now. I'll lower the sampler to 10% for node-join events for 30m. This reduces immediate egress risk.

eli: agreed — do both. Also create an alert: keystore.decrypt.failures > 5/min -> pager to eng-oncall so we don't miss regressions.

samir: prod change applied at 03:20 UTC after @maria quick ok via DM. Nodes have started rejoining, warm-pool healthy again. Monitoring: failed-joins dropped from 120/min to <2/min within 5m.

maria: thanks. follow-up actions: - ticket on infra board (owner=samir) to update ephemeral grant flow to include encryptionContext - add rollout canary for iam changes - postmortem if failed joins > 50 in next 24h

taylor: quick cost estimate: extra audit egress and retries ~ $1.2k, keystore ops ~ $0.8k for the blip window. I'll add to the invoice tracking ticket.

eli: sweet. closing the immediate thread — keep monitoring and flag if anything reappears. :thumbsup:

samir: created infra ticket INFRA-2481, assigning to self. will post progress in that ticket. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: note: sampler rate reverted to previous setting at 03:50 UTC (auto-rollback scheduled).

eli: thanks everyone. If we see a repeat, we escalate to sec for a faster rollback path.
